title: Active-versus-passive sensory coding
disposition_reason: Current source supports arbitrary complete 92-row velocity artifacts and a passive 40 query primary loss. It preserves a fixed active-versus-passive-reference diagnostic, but does not enforce matched kinematics, candidate active-only fitting or the broader causal-coding investigation.

scientific_target.question: How well does a decoder trained only on active reaches reconstruct nominal velocity on passive perturbations, and how does its transfer loss compare with same-information direction controls and a separately calibrated passive decoder?
scientific_target.known_answer: Two measured nominal velocity components in m/s per query, at the declared retrospective 120 msmovement-onset target.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Area 2_Bump Han 2017-12-07 behavioral measurements in the fixed 92 query packet.
scientific_target.case_unit: One trial-level two-component nominal velocity response, not the 30-bin trajectory of 021.
scientific_target.independent_unit: One Han macaque/session;40 passive primary and 52 active secondary trials.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Exposed within-session active-to-passive predictive transfer. Passive-trained comparison is privileged calibration; a difference does not isolate mechanism or prove matching of behavioral state.
exclusions: A candidate score is the fixed-reference active-minus-passive diagnostic.
Direction strata alone establish kinematic matching.
Causal sensory coding, online prediction, new-animal generalization or native-understanding performance.

observation_contract.case_identity: Exactly 92 unique 24 lowercase hex IDs in public order:40 passive and 52 active, all 8 directions in each mode. Actual packet identities are external; reordered output is rejected.
observation_contract.split: Fixed 141 active-only training to 40 passive primary+52 active secondaryqueries. Passive_neuralreference used extra passive labels and must remain separately identified; this is not matched-information candidate training.
observation_contract.coverage: Complete 92 two-value outputs and 16 mode×directionstrata; no omitted direction or query. The registered broader kinematic-matching investigation is not supplied by artifact grading.

primary.rationale: This is the implemented arbitrary-candidate target. Retain the original active-neural-minus-passive-neural reference contrast as a separate diagnostic rather than mislabeling it candidate performance.

nuisance_controls: Preserve all 8 commanded directions in each mode and their trial counts.
Audit kinematic overlap explicitly; direction stratification is insufficient matching.
Validate active-only method provenance outside artifact scorer and prohibit outcome-based reference selection.
evaluation.uncertainty: Paired complete-trial losses with direction/block dependence within one session; no 40 animal inference or mechanistic significance from an arbitrary positive contrast.
evaluation.failure_policy: All 92 ordered IDs and finite nonboolean 2-vectors required before private load; no candidate-selected reference identity. Keep poor predictions scored. Unsupported finite-overflow arithmetic yields null explicitly; shell exit 0 alone does not establish a valid score.
